# Radoslav Radev Requires Pressing The Parallettes Together And Pushing Forward And Down At The Same Time For Planche

Radoslav Radev requires pressing the parallettes together while pushing forward and down at the same time during a planche hold, which makes the biceps go forward and squeezes the lats better. [src: vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 03:37]

## Details

- Instead of just pushing forward and down, you have to push the parallettes together. [src: vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 03:37]
- Everything happens at the same time, not first forward, second down, and third like this. [src: vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 03:45]
- When your biceps go forward, you are squeezing the lats much better. [src: vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 03:55]
- When you do that, the scapula protraction goes up. [src: vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 04:01]

## Evidence

- vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 03:37 (Radoslav Radev): "press the parallettes together so instead of just pushing forward and down you have to push the parallettes together"
- vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 03:45 (Radoslav Radev): "Everything is in the same time. It's not first forward, second down, and third like this. It's in the same time."
- vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 03:55 (Radoslav Radev): "And your biceps going forward and when your biceps going forward, you're squeezing the lats much better."
- vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 04:01 (Radoslav Radev): "When you do that, the scapula protraction going up."
